entry.author: Whakatane.govt.nz
entry.summary: In line with Waka Kotahi | NZTA’s national changes to temporary traffic management, Kawerau District Council is transitioning to a risk‑based approach by 1 July 2026 for all new contracts and 1 January 2027 for all existing contracts. By prioritising risk-based planning, we improve the safety of both road workers and road users. This approach aligns with Waka Kotahi ‘Road to Zero’ campaign, supporting safer roads for all.
